summary: Admin invites page: the Expire button no longer puts the invite name inside inline JavaScript, fixing a bug where an apostrophe in the name broke the button and a crafted name could run script in an admin's browser (XSS); behaviour otherwise unchanged.

statements.why: The change removes a script-injection risk rather than adding one; same confirm/expire flow (home.blade.php).
True but says nothing about what changed.

misses.what: Security fix on the admin Invites page: a crafted invite name could run code in an admin's browser session when the page loaded/clicked; now the name is safely escaped.
Bug fix: the Expire button on admin invites no longer breaks when the invite name contains an apostrophe.
